To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ferrocene derived phosphine sulfonamide ligand 2c has been found to be effective in AgOAc promoted asymmetric [3+ 2] cyclo-addition of azomethylene ylide with aldehyde, and the reaction has been found to provide the cyclo-adduct in high yield and high enantioselectivity (up to 93% yield and 93% ee).

ferrocene derived phosphine sulfide ligands have been successfully used in AgOAC catalyzed asymmetric 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition reaction of azomethines and that planar chiral phosphines with electron withdrawing substituents are more effective in this reaction.
ferrocene derived phosphorous, sulphur donor ligands are effectively used for AgOAc catalysed asymmetric cycloadditions of azomethinie ylides.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of new chiral ferrocenyl phosphine-sulfide ligands and their application in asymmetric synthesis.
the synthesis of chiral ferrocenes and their applications in catalysis.
the synthesis and reactivity of ferrocene-based P,S-ligands.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the planar chirality of the phosphorus substituents is the most important factor in the enantioselectivity.
the planar chirality of the ligand plays a key role in achieving good enantioselectivity.
the planar chirality of the phosphorous moiety is a major factor for the enantioselectivity, but the electronic property is also an important factor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electronic properties of the P-atom and the planar chirality are the most important factors to control the enantioselectivity.
planar chirality plays a crucial role in determining the enantioselectivity in Ag-catalyzed asymmetric [2 + 3] cycloadditions of azomethines with chiral ferrocyne derived P,S ligand.
the electronic properties of the P-aryl substituent play a major role in the enantioselectivity of the reaction, while planar chirality is not so important.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electronic properties of phosphine substituents can be used to fine tune the enantioselectivity of the reaction.
the planar chirality of the phosphorous ligand has a significant impact on the stereochemical outcome of the reaction.
a planar chiral ferrocenylphosphine is a very effective auxiliary to promote the cycloaddition reaction.
